answer.reason: The verses state what was done with the jar: it was filled with manna and laid up before the LORD.

clauses.english: was filled with an omer of manna and laid up before the LORD to be kept for Israel's generations
clauses.quote: put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD

doubts: HEB 9:4 places the golden pot in the ark of the covenant; left out as a separate detail from a different book that may not match Exodus' placement before the Testimony.
